# Global Equity Rotation Checkup

Report 161 | Published 2025-04-27 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2025-4-27/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/161.json)

Global rotation, fiscal persistence and contrasting entry outcomes.

The TSM-over-RTX switch and AMD and USB entries received strong support. Bitcoin’s six-month gain became a twelve-month loss and its proposed floor failed. Ulta’s earnings caution was partly right despite a rising stock. Fiscal skepticism was supported; the multi-year international and China theses remain open.

**Coverage:** Full numbered text and image inventory read. All material theses across macro, digital assets, investment analysis and concluding sections considered. Position listings and incidental descriptive statistics are excluded unless they support a thesis.

## Claims

### 161-C08

**Dollar weakness eases foreign debt burdens.**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Right |
| Type | explanation |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | dollar-liability-currency-channel |
| Source blocks | 27, 28, 30, 145 |
| Thesis family | dollar-liability-currency-channel |

For unchanged dollar liabilities and local-currency resources, dollar depreciation reduces the local-currency debt burden. The total effect also depends on export prices, hedges and financing access. Calling every dollar decline an increase in global liquidity is broader than this bounded mechanism.

**Direction:** See assessment; evidence is limited to the stated proposition.

**Timing:** No fixed deadline stated.

**Mechanism:** Price direction alone does not identify causation.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Deductive assessment:**

- Debt fixed in dollars
- Local-currency resources unchanged
- No offsetting hedge

Local debt burden equals dollar debt times local-currency units per dollar; a lower exchange rate reduces the burden.

**Outcome evidence:**

No independent outcome source is recorded. Any deductive assessment is identified separately.

- China weight below 100%
- Compare the same direct China shock
- Other holdings unchanged

Portfolio loss from the direct shock equals China weight times its loss; a smaller weight reduces that direct contribution.

## Analytical tools and charts

- **Gold-adjusted GDPNow:** Separate model artifact from domestic demand Visual inspection: not performed.
- **Domestic liquidity:** Fed, TGA and RRP interaction Visual inspection: not performed.
- **MVRV, RSI and MACD:** Cost basis and momentum, not calibrated floor probabilities Visual inspection: not performed.
- **Relative equity ratios:** Compare countries on a common currency and total-return basis Visual inspection: not performed.
- **FAST Graphs:** Distinguish historical earnings from analyst forecasts Visual inspection: not performed.

## Framework lessons

- A horizon range requires reporting both endpoints.
- A correct earnings concern does not establish a correct stock sale.

## Verification limitations

- Current page snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date version.
- A missing horizon is not replaced with an invented author deadline.
- Market sensitivities use vendor adjusted closes and do not reconstruct portfolio execution.
